item.title: One Small Thing
item.description:
Over the past 17 years, I’ve met a lot of teams and leaders who were sure that the way they worked was the only way to get things done.

I’ve been that person. I was sure story points didn’t work, until I met a team full of talented, smart, hardworking people who stuck with them and had massive success. That doesn’t make story points right for every team. It made me realize that the important question isn’t whether a process is universally right or wrong. It’s whether we’re intentional about why we’re doing it, and willing to look again when our circumstances change.
